A connector_action naming a registered connector but an unknown action (rest.nope_action) → trigger 400 FLOW_FAILED "no handler for 'rest.nope_action' — is the connector plugin registered?" (loud; the hint names the plugin though the plugin is registered and only the action is unknown — diagnostic wording only). Scratch flows deleted (200). Nothing found.
- automation.screen-flow-roundtrip: 2 min. Resume of a completed run → 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND "No suspended run 'run_3749a37c…'"; resume of an unknown run id → 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND; GET /screen of a completed run → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "No pending screen for run". Nothing found.
- automation.connector-dispatch-matrix: 2 min. A registered connector with an unknown action (rest.nope_action) → 400 "no handler for 'rest.nope_action' — is the connector plugin registered?": loud, but the hint blames the plugin when only the action is unknown. Nothing found beyond that wording note.
- automation.flow-runs-page-test-trigger: 1 min. Folded into S9 (dismiss + Continue run). Nothing found.
- automation.flow-reference-package-resolution: 1 min. Only the second qa_b_env trigger after the dependency change (N1). Nothing found.
- integration-system.flow-connector-picker: 2 min. Switched mcp → slack and read each pick's action datalist; each was re-derived, with no stale actions carried over. Nothing found.
- integration-system.webhook-lifecycle: 3 min. definition_json/column trigger divergence (above). Redeliver with snake_case key (400 as documented). Nothing else found.
- integration-system.job-scheduled-run: 2 min. Install-door refusal of handler jobs; qa_c_cron '* * * * *' Asia/Shanghai fired at 11:23:00Z and 11:24:00Z. Nothing else found.
- integration-system.email-template-render: 2 min. A string fromOverride (422, as the clause says), and a 3-recipient fan-out with mixed locales in one node. Nothing found.
- integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery: 3 min. On /notifications/read: ids [] → 200 readCount 0; {} and ids:"x" → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED naming ids; a cross-user id → readCount 0, no effect on its owner; anonymous POST /read/all → 401. Nothing found.
- integration-system.job-package-key: 1 min. Install-door refusal of a handler-only job (above). Nothing else found.
- integration-system.federation-only-driver-catalog: 1 min. Returning to PostgreSQL after SQL Server keeps External selected (it does not restore the earlier Managed). That is consistent with the clause. Nothing found.
- integration-system.push-device-registry-and-relay-boot: 2 min. platform 'bogus' → 400 naming the platform enum; origin with an uppercase host (http://LOCALHOST:3000) → 400 origin; empty token → 400 "Push Token is required"; anonymous POST /devices → 401. Nothing found.
- platform-core.notification-center: 1 min. Console during the session: only the pre-auth 401 at sign-in. Nothing found.
- search.console-global-search: 2 min. The member palette session logged one 404 resource error, not on the search door: every search request answered 200. Searching the member's own invoice works. A 1-character CJK query sends no request. Nothing found.
